mentions.note: in final of 1925 Club 1 mile championship

photos.c: Above: The 1925 Club Championships at Battersea Park. The final of the 1 mile championship for the Garnet Cup. Left to right: H.E.Footer, K.O'Kell, A.D.Pyer, G.J.Rees, W.D.Pritchard and F.L.Buckingham. The winner was Ken, in 4:41.2, from Buckingham and Footer. Just look at the crowds!

share.d: G.J. Rees in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1992: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 photograph.
